text:
Updated `HelpFormatter.write_dl` to account for the options section’s indentation when calculating the description wrapping width.

Previously, descriptions could use the full remaining width without subtracting the section indent, producing lines wider than the configured terminal. Now option descriptions wrap so the complete rendered line stays within the terminal width.

final_text:
Updated `HelpFormatter.write_dl` to account for the options section’s indentation when calculating the description wrapping width.

Previously, descriptions could use the full remaining width without subtracting the section indent, producing lines wider than the configured terminal. Now option descriptions wrap so the complete rendered line stays within the terminal width.
